newsitem.title: USA: Lexigton buys two facilities from Beverly.
newsitem.headline: Lexigton buys two facilities from Beverly.

text.p: Lexington Healthcare Group Inc said Thursday it signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets of two skilled nursing facilities in Connecticut from Beverly Enterprises Inc.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Lexington said that the addition of the two facilities would add about $15 million in gross revenues to the company, increasing its total annual revenues to about $57 million.
Lexington provides management, healthcare and ancillary services to long term and home healthcare industries.
